# Lab 27.2: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a dataset, a partitioned table, an IAM grant and a scheduled query with Terraform, then change and destroy them safely.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Write the configuration.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p tf_bq &amp;&amp; cd tf_bq
cat &gt; main.tf &lt;&lt;'EOF'
variable "project_id" {}
provider "google" { project = var.project_id }

resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "lab27" {
  dataset_id  = "lab27_tf"
  location    = "US"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  labels      = { course = "bigquery", managed_by = "terraform" }
}

resource "google_bigquery_table" "events" {
  dataset_id          = google_bigquery_dataset.lab27.dataset_id
  table_id            = "events"
  deletion_protection = false
  time_partitioning { type = "DAY", field = "event_ts" }
  clustering        = ["event_type"]
  schema = jsonencode([
    { name = "event_ts", type = "TIMESTAMP", mode = "REQUIRED" },
    { name = "event_type", type = "STRING" },
    { name = "user_id", type = "INT64" }
  ])
}

resource "google_bigquery_dataset_iam_member" "viewer" {
  dataset_id = google_bigquery_dataset.lab27.dataset_id
  role       = "roles/bigquery.dataViewer"
  member     = "serviceAccount:bq-analyst@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_bigquery_data_transfer_config" "daily_count" {
  display_name           = "tf_daily_count"
  location               = "US"
  data_source_id         = "scheduled_query"
  schedule               = "every 24 hours"
  destination_dataset_id = google_bigquery_dataset.lab27.dataset_id
  params = {
    destination_table_name_template = "daily_counts"
    write_disposition               = "WRITE_APPEND"
    query                           = "SELECT CURRENT_DATE() AS day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `${var.project_id}.lab27_tf.events`"
  }
}
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Plan and apply.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">terraform init
terraform plan -var="project_id=$PROJECT_ID"
terraform apply -auto-approve -var="project_id=$PROJECT_ID"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Check the resources.** `lab27_tf.events` is partitioned and clustered, the analyst has viewer access, and the scheduled query exists.

4. **[CLI] Make a change.** Add `{ name = "country", type = "STRING" }` to the schema and run `terraform plan`. Terraform shows an in-place update (adding a column is safe).

5. **[CLI] See drift.** Add a label in the console, then run `terraform plan` again. Terraform wants to remove it. Code is the source of truth.

6. **[CLI] Destroy.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">terraform destroy -auto-approve -var="project_id=$PROJECT_ID"
cd ..</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Resources | Dataset, table, IAM, scheduled query |
| Plan | Shows changes before applying |
| Drift | Manual changes detected |
| Destroy | Everything removed cleanly |
